code_proofs.description: query_value_fmt passes group ordinal into the SUID getter; default comes directly from descriptor.
SUID lookup rejects values with no0x1F00bits.
get_simple consumes two16-bit SUID/index arguments; printing concatenated high/low hex does not change call semantics.
get_simple helper requires registryentry+4 simple-table pointer nonzero.
Named descriptor registration stores pointer atentry+0 and zero atentry+4, explaining rejection by get_simple.

corrections_to_earlier_review.earlier_assumption: The same named-table SUID/index could be read through this wrapper.
corrections_to_earlier_review.correction: The argument encoding was correct, but the wrapper explicitly requires the alternative simple-table representation. Named descriptor tables clear that pointer. Preserve all four rejected physical37 attempts; no unsupported packed-half retry is warranted.

An empty listing does not prove absence of registered strings. The round3 hold remains valid because a supported string identifier and size were not established; the reason should not claim an empty registry.
